Let's make unique identifiers by combining the Accession_string and sequence for those probes for which toGeneid function will fail probedf$unique <- paste0(probedf$SEQUENCE, ":", probedf$ACCESSION_STRING) # retain only legacy IDs that map unambiguously to one current gene. new <- toGeneid(inputid = unique(probedf$ACCESSION_STRING), from = "old", to = "ensembl") %>%   dplyr::select(`Input ID`, `Gene ID`) %>% dplyr::distinct() resolved <- new %>% dplyr::group_by(`Input ID`) %>%   dplyr::filter(dplyr::n_distinct(`Gene ID`) == 1L) %>% dplyr::ungroup()  ix <- match(probedf$ACCESSION_STRING, resolved$`Input ID`) probedf$`Gene ID` <- resolved$`Gene ID`[ix] unmappedprobes_df <- probedf[is.na(probedf$`Gene ID`) &                                !is.na(probedf$SEQUENCE) & nzchar(probedf$SEQUENCE),                              c("ACCESSION_STRING", "SEQUENCE", "unique"), drop = FALSE] ## retriving mRNA from plasmoDB readVEuPathFasta <- function(url,                              api_key = Sys.getenv("VEUPATHDB_API_KEY"),                              timeout = 60) {    if (!nzchar(api_key)) stop("VEuPathDB API key is missing.")   tmp <- tempfile(fileext = ".fasta")   on.exit(unlink(tmp), add = TRUE)   httr2::request(url) |>     httr2::req_auth_bearer_token(api_key) |>     httr2::req_timeout(timeout) |>     httr2::req_perform(path = tmp)   Biostrings::readDNAStringSet(tmp) }  mrna_fasta <- readVEuPathFasta(     paste0(         "https://plasmodb.org/a/service/raw-files/release-71/",         "Pfalciparum3D7/fasta/data/",         "PlasmoDB-71_Pfalciparum3D7_AnnotatedTranscripts.fasta"     ) )  # extract transcript identifiers and require a UNIQUE gene-level match. names(mrna_fasta) <- sub("[[:space:]].*$", "", names(mrna_fasta))  probe_matches_zero <- lapply(unmappedprobes_df$SEQUENCE, function(seq) {   Biostrings::vmatchPattern(seq, mrna_fasta, max.mismatch = 0) })  # A probe matching several transcripts is acceptable only when all # matching transcripts resolve to one gene. Otherwise leave it ambiguous. exact_gene_hits <- lapply(probe_matches_zero, function(matches) {   transcript_ids <- names(mrna_fasta)[lengths(matches) > 0L]   gene_ids <- sub("\\.[0-9]+$", "", transcript_ids)   gene_ids <- sub("-T[0-9]+$", "", gene_ids)   unique(gene_ids) }) unique_hit <- vapply(exact_gene_hits, function(ids) {   if (length(ids) == 1L) ids else NA_character_ }, character(1))  # map by original probe row; do not expand ExpressionSet features. missing_ix <- which(is.na(probedf$`Gene ID`) & !is.na(probedf$SEQUENCE) &                       nzchar(probedf$SEQUENCE)) probedf$`Gene ID`[missing_ix] <- unique_hit  #explicitly reporting unresolved/multi-mapping probes for manual review. ambiguous <- vapply(exact_gene_hits, length, integer(1)) > 1L message(sum(ambiguous), " probes match multiple distinct genes and were not assigned.") unresolved <- is.na(probedf$`Gene ID`)  ## Adding a prefix to remove unmapped reads later when required probedf$`Gene ID`[unresolved] <- paste0("UNMAPPED:",     probedf$ACCESSION_STRING[unresolved], ":", rownames(probedf)[unresolved])   stopifnot(nrow(probedf) == nrow(Biobase::fData(gse)))   stopifnot(identical(rownames(probedf), Biobase::featureNames(gse)))

Using all genes captured as a background  background.gset <- rownames(SummarizedExperiment::assay(subudhi2020, "counts")) stopifnot(all(names(p_values) %in% background.gset)) #selected genes must belong to the background  easytopGOVEuPath <- function(     gaf,     api_key = Sys.getenv("VEUPATHDB_API_KEY"),     timeout = 60,     ... ) {   if (!nzchar(api_key)) stop("VEuPathDB API key is missing.")    gaf_tmp <- tempfile(fileext = ".gaf")    # Clean up after function finishes   on.exit(     unlink(c(gaf_tmp)),     add = TRUE   )    # Download GAF   httr2::request(gaf) |>     httr2::req_auth_bearer_token(api_key) |>     httr2::req_timeout(timeout) |>     httr2::req_perform(path = gaf_tmp)    # Pass the locally downloaded GAF to easytopGO()   easytopGO(geneID = p_values,             useGAF = TRUE,             useBiomart = FALSE,             gaf=gaf_tmp,             bkggset = background.gset,              category = "BP", stats = "fisher",             algo = "classic", fdr = TRUE, correction = "BH", ...)  }   ## Making circular plot goplt + ggplot2::theme_minimal() + ggplot2::coord_polar() + ggplot2::ylab("") library(org.Pfalciparum3D7.eg.db) pfdb <- org.Pfalciparum3D7.eg.db  ## res is the result obtained from DESeq2 res <- ggVolcano::add_regulate(res, log2FC_name = "log2FoldChange",              fdr_name = "padj",log2FC = 1, fdr = 0.05) res <- res[!duplicated(res$`Gene ID`),] ## ensuring only one entry of gene duplicates is retained   ok <- !is.na(res$padj) & !is.na(res$`Gene ID`) background.gset <- res$`Gene ID`[ok] down <- ok & !is.na(res$log2FoldChange) &   res$regulate == "Up" geneList <- stats::setNames(res$padj[down], res$`Gene ID`[down])   gores.fisher <- easytopGO(   geneID = geneList,    bkggset = background.gset,   algo = "classic",   OrgDb = pfdb, orgdb_keytype = "GID",    useBiomart = FALSE, useGAF = FALSE,   stats = "fisher", category = "BP",    fdr = TRUE, correction = "BH" ) ## Examplary code to use KS  # Retain eligible genes with positive fold changes # Exclude missing adjusted p-values ok.up <- !is.na(res$`Gene ID`) &   nzchar(as.character(res$`Gene ID`)) &   !is.na(res$log2FoldChange) &   res$log2FoldChange > 0 &   !is.na(res$padj) &   !is.na(res$pvalue) &   is.finite(res$pvalue) &   res$pvalue >= 0 &   res$pvalue <= 1  up_universe <- res[ok.up, , drop = FALSE]  # Using genuine raw p-values as continuous KS scores because we are using a continuous ranking statistic. BH-adjusted p-values can also be used, but adjustment may introduce extra ties and change the ranking. up_ks_vector <- stats::setNames(   up_universe$pvalue,   as.character(up_universe$`Gene ID`) )  # Use exactly the same genes as the KS background up_background <- names(up_ks_vector)  # Perform KS enrichment gores.ks.up <- easytopGO(   geneID = up_ks_vector,   bkggset = up_background,   algo = "classic",   gaf = "PlasmoDB-71_Pfalciparum3D7_GO.gaf",   useBiomart = FALSE,   useGAF = TRUE,   stats = "ks",   category = "BP",   fdr = TRUE,   correction = "BH" ) # Which GO terms have stronger differential-expression signals among positively/negatively changing genes
